## What I'm looking for

Engineering roles in AI infrastructure, backend, or platform work — new-grad positions and internships both, from September 2026. Particular interest in inference serving and the queues around it, retrieval systems that have to be right rather than plausible, observability, distributed systems where correctness under failure is the requirement, developer platforms, and cost-aware infrastructure. Also open to project collaborations.

## Currently

Operating rather than only building: a two-machine [homelab](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/homelab.html) running 19 rootless podman containers as systemd Quadlets, with split-horizon DNS, digest-pinned images, SELinux enforcing, an incident log with postmortems, and a weekly job that restores a random sample of the offsite backup and checksums it. Working toward platform and reliability engineering — deeper Kubernetes, and the distributed-systems fundamentals behind consensus, backpressure, and failure detection.

## Focus areas

Shipping AI features with real engineering rigor: computer vision, retrieval-augmented generation, and LLM pipelines built on async processing queues, Kubernetes workloads on AWS, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and instrumentation with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

## Projects

- [RetailOS Lite](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/retailos-lite.html): AI-native retail execution platform. Async BullMQ pipeline running YOLO shelf analysis plus LLM reasoning, with Prometheus queue metrics and a DLQ replay CLI; a 5-signal calibrated fraud engine (SHA-256, dHash, GPS mismatch, EXIF) that runs before expensive GPU work; weighted outlet similarity matching (pg_trgm + geo prefilter) with three-tier resolution and non-destructive duplicate merging; a two-tier RAG assistant combining exact Prisma queries with Pinecone semantic search. Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, FastAPI, BullMQ, YOLO, Prisma, Modal GPU, Pinecone, Prometheus, Grafana. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/RetailOS-Lite
- [DeliveryLens](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/deliverylens.html): AI delivery-intelligence assistant built during an AI engineering internship (sanitised public version, organisation and client identifiers removed). Answers project status, blockers and team tracking from a local Postgres mirror of GitHub and a task tracker rather than calling those APIs live. Core rule: the model writes the prose but never carries a number — 16 typed Zod tools run SQL, and every tool result goes both to the model and to a view builder that renders charts and tables from the same JSON with no model in the path. Prose questions go to an indexed corpus: pgvector/HNSW vector search and Postgres full-text search run together, fuse by reciprocal rank, and are reranked by a Cohere cross-encoder, with the per-document cap applied after scoring so it never reorders results; if the reranker errors the system degrades to a diversity fallback and records which path ran. Aggregates ship with their denominators and caveats, incomparable roles are ranked in separate groups, zero-activity accounts are listed rather than ranked, identity links are human-confirmed not guessed, and authorization is a separate allowlist that fails closed on empty. Branch-aware incremental GitHub sync with per-repo watermarks, written after a 65-branch repository exhausted the hourly rate limit. Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Neon Postgres, pgvector, TypeORM, Zod, Cohere Rerank, Recharts, Vercel. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/DeliveryLens
- [Deskemy](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/deskemy.html): Offline course player for Windows, and the project with real users — 52 GitHub stars, 261 installer/portable downloads across 6 releases, 3 forks, and a community-maintained Simplified Chinese translation. Tauri v2 shell with a Rust core; playback drives libmpv through runtime FFI (libloading, bundled libmpv-2.dll) rather than an HTML5 video tag, so it plays whatever codecs a downloaded course ships with. Native video renders to a DirectComposition surface behind a transparent WebView2, keeping player chrome and panels as real DOM on top. Two-phase importer (probe then persist) keeps media probing off the database connection. Progress and bookmarks survive renames because lectures are matched by content, not path. SQLite FTS5 powers title search plus optional subtitle search that jumps to the spoken timestamp. No accounts, no telemetry, no network calls for your content; portable mode writes nothing outside its own folder. MIT. Stack: Rust, Tauri v2, Svelte 5, SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, libmpv, SQLite/FTS5, rusqlite, DirectComposition, WebView2. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/Deskemy
- [HomeLab](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/homelab.html): Two-host self-hosted platform, run as production rather than as a hobby — this is the operations counterpart to the build-focused projects. 19 rootless podman containers on AlmaLinux defined as declarative systemd Quadlets (no root daemon, no compose), with linger so everything starts at boot unattended. Images pinned by @sha256: digest so a pull can never silently change what runs. SELinux stays enforcing, with per-path relabel decisions rather than a blanket :Z. Bulk volume mounted by UUID with nofail because device names are not stable, and RequiresMountsFor on every writer so nothing starts before the disk mounts and writes into the root filesystem instead. Storage placement is dictated by a drive-managed SMR platter that stalls under random writes: databases, thumbnails, configs and caches on SSD, only large sequential data on the platter. Split-horizon DNS serves one set of .home names to two audiences — a LAN resolver for guests and a tailnet-only resolver reached through a Tailscale split-DNS rule scoped to .home — both pointing at the same Caddy listening on all interfaces. Behind CGNAT, so no inbound connectivity exists by design. Backups use copy with a timestamped backup-dir rather than sync, because sync would replicate a bad delete to the only offsite copy; the encrypted remote exposes no usable plaintext hashes, so a weekly job restores 15 random files, decrypts and checksums them against the originals, and publishes ok/warn/fail as JSON on the dashboard. Includes an incident log with real postmortems, a symptom-to-document runbook, and documented open gaps. Configuration is private (credentials and key material); the case study is the write-up.
- [ShelfWatch](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/shelfwatch.html): Retail inventory analysis with dense product detection. Fine-tuned YOLOv11L on AWS EKS as a microserviced deployment, compiled into an in-process ONNX Runtime engine with INT8 quantization; 4x CPU inference speedup and 70–90% cost savings via INT8 quantization, AMX, and Spot diversification; GitOps delivery with Helm and ArgoCD; canary releases with Argo Rollouts; Loki/Prometheus/Grafana observability; DevSecOps in GitHub Actions with Trivy and pip-audit. Stack: Python, YOLOv11, AWS EKS, FastAPI, Docker, ONNX. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/ShelfWatch
- [PixTools](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/pixtools.html): Distributed async image processing platform. HTTP edge migrated from FastAPI to Go with full contract parity; dual-node K3s cluster on AWS (On-Demand control plane, Spot data plane) under full Terraform IaC; RabbitMQ-queued Celery workers with dedicated queues to prevent starvation; Redis idempotency keys, pybreaker circuit breakers, k6 load tests; zero-trust GitHub Actions OIDC CI/CD; traces to Grafana LGTM via Alloy. Stack: Go, Python, Celery, RabbitMQ, Terraform, AWS, K3s, Redis. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/PixTools
- [NeoAlarm](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/neoalarm.html): Reliability-first Android alarm app. Flutter UI shell over a Kotlin alarm engine that owns scheduling, ringing, recovery, and dismissal authority; geofenced location alarms via GeofencingClient with hybrid approach-assist and a 10-state per-alarm health model; mission-based dismissal with native inactivity enforcement (math, step detector, QR via CameraX + ML Kit); direct-boot persistence and reboot recovery before first unlock. Stack: Flutter, Kotlin, CameraX, ML Kit, AlarmManager, MapLibre. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/NeoAlarm
- [StatusMonitor](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/statusmonitor.html): Distributed infrastructure uptime monitoring in Go, with real-time dashboards and cross-platform agents. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/StatusMonitor
- [Crawler RAG DocHelper](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/crawler-rag.html): Retrieval-Augmented Generation on constrained hardware. Hybrid dense-sparse retrieval in Pinecone, ingestion by crawling llms.txt via Tavily with caching, Cohere Rerank ahead of Gemini 2.5 generation, and query-time alpha weighting to trade keyword precision against semantic recall.
- [interviewPrepper](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/interview-prepper.html): AI interview preparation platform. Multi-step LangGraph/LangChain agents generate 30-day curricula; cross-LLM routing across OpenAI, Google Gemini, and OpenRouter; persistent SQLite conversation threading for refinements; Firecrawl scraping with Tavily search fallback. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/interviewPrepper
- [RoutineMaker](https://nayeemfardin.vercel.app/routine-maker.html): Microservices routine manager. Separate FastAPI auth and core services isolated in Docker behind an Nginx API gateway; Argon2 hashing, JWT auth, configured CORS; automated PDF schedule export. Stack: FastAPI, React, Docker, PostgreSQL, Nginx. Code: https://github.com/NFRohan/routineMaker
